begin.policy: Fixed training-only examples; diagnostic autograd.grad does not populate optimizer .grad.

end.policy: Fixed training-only examples; diagnostic autograd.grad does not populate optimizer .grad.

canonical_panel.evaluation_policy: Separate corrected encoder domain; original historical tensors, counts and masks remain unchanged

identity.scope: Existing plain head only with pooled teacher waveform and unchanged long-mel supervision. No separate quiet weighting, WN, short mel, GAN, new layer or automatic promotion.

coefficient-calibration.policy: Same output-gradient-energy calibration as v2 on first four fixed training batches; long-mel initially equals sample-pooled teacher waveform gradient norm. No short spectral branch. Quiet/active energies are diagnostics only, not separate loss weights.

final_scalar_flags.meaning: Engineering reconstruction screen; not perceptual equivalence or production approval

fit-accounting.baseline: Same retained candidate; waveform normalization comes from fixed teacher targets, not baseline errors

counts.policy: One immutable teacher RMS-squared over all valid fit samples. No separate quiet/active normalization, per-source RMS normalization or baseline-error scale.
